changelog: Custom providers: one-tap free model presets for DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama and Google Gemini (OpenRouter), with a free Gemma group
A new OpenRouter provider now starts with every preset model, so the Claude model picker is filled automatically instead of typing model ids by hand
Preset models merge into an existing OpenRouter provider with duplicate detection, plus an 'Add all' action
Includes the 1.0.19 persistent signing fix, restored proot/loader binaries and the hub startup/restart/CSRF fixes
